description: Was this coin bundled at launch? Returns the saved unbundle launch check for a Solana token address or a Robinhood Chain (0x…) token address: verdict (bundled, likely, creator-held, some signs, clean), the key number, plain-English reasons and a link to the full report. If the coin has not been checked yet, returns a link to run a free check.
